snippet.title: Marathon (Sonic '06) Recompiled | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Marathon Recompiled is an unofficial PC port of the Xbox 360 version of Sonic the Hedgehog (2006) created through the process of static recompilation.

Download Marathon Recompiled from GitHub: https://github.com/sonicnext-dev/MarathonRecomp
